👍 Don't forget to Like and Collect this, so you can easily find it later! ⭐
If you like my models and what I do then come follow me on Patreon https://www.patreon.com/c/Adamnant for updates on my quests and access to exclusive minis.

I recently finished the Relic Sloth model and part of that included some various packs / bags / bedrolls etc... so I wanted to make sure those were available as separate items as well. You can find the relic Sloth here: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:7202569

The bag of coins originates from my bag jelly model as well over here: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:7192928

In here I've got 5 x different packs and a bedroll as well as 2x arrangements. You can print out the whole versions, sliced/flattened versions or the arrangements.

Edit: Update Nov 24, I played around and remade the giant space hamster bag by hand. I've added a huge, large and medium version of that bag / pack to this collection. Also added a grain sack / bag with ropes around it.

These are fairly low detail models because they're so small. They could absolutely be 1,000,000 vertices and have details on all the straps and clips etc... but that's not very likely to show up on prints (and there are many other high fidelity pack models out there if you want that). This set will get the "scatter" job done and won't stress out your printer in the process.

I've completed my quest for 1000 models in 2025 so now I'm trying to decide whats next. You can follow along with me on Thingiverse, Printables, Cults3d or provide suggestions on Patreon here: https://www.patreon.com/c/Adamnant (as well as get codes for exclusive downloads on Cults3d). If you have something that you need or a custom model like this that you want then let me know and let's make it!

100% untested.

This was me challenging myself to make armour in fusion as helmets are more my thing.

You might use it all , you might not.

You might you some bits and not others.

You might use it for custom builds.

All good with me.

The helmet has been designed to use JJ industries Metal stalk and stalk lock system.
https://store.jjindustries.co.uk/products/sabine-wren-stalk

A Stl for JJ industries stalk is included in the files.

I thank Luke for letting use his design.

The gauntlets are hollow allowing for electronics. As are all the light up parts... they are all shelled hollow so can be printed in transparent resin and lights placed behind.

Hey folks! Just 3 parts for you to place in your miniatures to customize your characters. Extra thick to increase compatibility. Heavily based in historic milanese armor (high waist large shoulder piece, few folds)
My process to adapt them (blender 2.8+):
1- Load your miniature and the armor parts
2- Place them more or less in position
3- Get the best fit you can simply scaling it (if some parts of the mini stick out, don't worry, get the overall placement)
4 - Try sculpting down (elastic deform brush in blender works wonders!) the parts sticking out in the original mini.
5- Use the sculpting elastic deform to give the final touches.

It normally takes less than 5 min for even somewhat complex models!

Hope you enjoy it!
